name: Prom
payout: Coolest is crowned Prom King/Queen: 5. Most Important: 3.
story: The crown goes to the coolest kid; the photographer wants the best dressed.

name: Student Council Election
story: Nobody reads the platforms.

name: Homecoming Court
story: Royalty needs status and charm.

name: School Picture Day
story: The yearbook gives last place the Most Memorable award.
notes: At 2 players: Cutest 4, the other player 3.

name: Science Fair
story: The lab coat wins; the judges don't trust anyone in sunglasses.

name: Field Trip
story: The wackiest kid spends the trip on the bus.
notes: At 2 players: the less Wacky player scores 3.

name: Talent Show
story: The most boring act goes viral.
notes: If 3 or more players tie for least, they each score 2.

name: Battle of the Bands
story: Rock stars need attitude and showmanship.

name: Fall Fling
payout: Everyone scores 1 Like for every 3 Cute and Wacky combined, up to 3.
story: It's just a dance; everyone posts their fit.

name: Yearbook Superlatives
payout: Wackiest is Class Clown: 4. Spookiest is Most Likely to Haunt the School: 4.
story: Two awards nobody campaigns for.

name: Detention
story: Rebels get respect; teacher's pets don't.

name: Club Officer Election
story: One runs the meetings, one runs the parties.

name: Up for a Promotion
story: Dress for the job you want, not the circus you want.

name: Job Interview
payout: Everyone with 4+ Important is hired: 2. Most Important also gets the corner office: 2 more.
story: Nobody checked the resumes.

name: Meeting the In-Laws
story: They want someone sweet, not someone who brought a bat.

name: Baby Shower
payout: Cutest 4, 2nd 2. Everyone with 0 Spooky gets 1 more.
story: Nobody wants fangs near the baby.

name: Wedding
story: Never upstage the couple.
notes: At 2 players: the less Important player scores 3.

name: Reading of the Will
payout: Most Important inherits the company: 4. Spookiest inherits the haunted mansion: 4.
story: Great-aunt had two kinds of heirs in mind.

name: Family Photo Day
payout: Out-Cute the player on your right: 3.
story: Grandma is comparing.

name: Kid's Birthday Party
payout: Everyone with 3+ Wacky: 2. Wackiest also gets booked for next year: 2 more.
story: The kids decide who's fun.

name: 21st Birthday
payout: Score your lower of Cool and Wacky. 1st 4, 2nd 2.
story: Be fun, but not a mess.
notes: The only balance invite; slower to score.

name: Halloween Party
story: The costume contest.

name: New Year's Eve
payout: Most Important gets the VIP table: 4. Wackiest leads the countdown: 4.
story: Two ways to own midnight.

name: 4th of July
story: Nobody wears a suit to a barbecue.

name: Turkey Trot
payout: Everyone scores 1 Like for every 2 Cute, up to 3.
story: Nobody's racing; everyone's posting.

name: Ugly Sweater Party
story: Trying to look cool is the one way to lose.

name: Haunted House Tour
story: The staff think the spookiest guest works there; the least spooky guest's scream goes viral.
notes: If 3 or more players tie for least, they each score 2.

name: Ski Trip
story: Last place's wipeout video goes viral.
notes: At 2 players: Coolest 4, the other player 3.

name: Beach Day
story: Leave the briefcase at home.

name: Fancy Restaurant
payout: Everyone with 3+ Important gets seated: 3. Most Important scores 0 instead.
story: The most important-looking guest gets stuck with the bill.

name: Camping Trip
payout: Spookiest 3, 2nd 2. Everyone with 0 Important gets 1 more.
story: Best campfire ghost story, plus points for roughing it.

name: Sleepover
story: Ghost stories in onesies.

name: Art Gallery Opening
story: The art crowd wants moody, not loud.

name: Goth Concert
story: The bunny ears are a dealbreaker.

name: Vampire Movie Premiere
story: The fans dress like the vampires they love.

name: First Date
story: Don't try too hard.
notes: At 2 players: the less Cool player scores 3.

name: Red Carpet Premiere
story: Least Important tops the worst-dressed list, and that's still press.
notes: If 3 or more players tie for least, they each score 1.

name: Circus Audition
story: There's only one opening.

name: Pet Adoption Day
story: The puppy picks the cutest person in the room.

name: Mystery Dinner Party
story: The spookiest guest obviously did it.
notes: At 2 players: the less Spooky player scores 3.
